notes.title: The Big Loop Studios Bundle
notes.content:
[h3] Big News about a Big Bundle! 🍂🍁[/h3]

We've decided to launch a bundle, containing our best titles on Steam!

[h3] Get Doors: Paradox, Machine City: Airborne & Tiny Robots: Recharged for a special price today![/h3]

We hope you enjoy!

A gentle reminder that you can check out our new project Boxes: Lost Fragments. It's coming out January 11th and there's a free demo on the Steam page below.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2019810/Boxes_Lost_Fragments/
